# Product experience and interface design — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Design the product experience from research and PRD through IA, flows, states, visual direction, design system, screens and accessibility, with design QA against the specification and later against the implementation.

**Trigger:** A PRD exists and the product experience needs design, or an implemented UI needs design review.
